methods: Extract the complete primary and candidate-companion files with PyMuPDF sort=False, independently of the previous sorted text; retain all pages and source identities. Use the frozen pypdf text as a separate reader.
Use independent labelled-sentence date and gross-cash grammars, never quantfolio.distributions extraction/scope functions. Treat date grids through the existing independent geometric cell review.

Gross cash needs explicit currency, per-share/per-ten-share units, gross-tax qualification, and a current implementation section or explicitly current first-page summary. Historical approvals, proposals, tax-after amounts and ex-reference calculations do not establish the current recipient amount.

Retain all other recognized gross-cash statements and their scope classifications. Missing or conflicting current values block independent acceptance. Compare both original stored and structured-provider values under the unchanged Decimal 1e-12 rule; do not rewrite the stored floating-point amount.

Adjacent-page evidence must retain both physical pages. Only recognized paired page counters matching physical page and total may be omitted for a boundary; arbitrary text and standalone numeric tokens remain. Never repair a split numeric cash token.

Independently bind the labelled issuer code and catalogue/body title; security short-name aliases need explicit first-page evidence. Reordered sorted-reader titles require original-page/geometry review, not fuzzy matching.

All failures and unsupported contexts remain. No runtime input, strategy, historical account, candidate budget or paper-plan changes. Source financial acceptance still requires related-amendment review and explicit outcomes for the full 387-event residual scope.
